 In The High Court At Calcutta

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction Subha Item no.32 Crr 1916 of 2021 Ct no.34 Sri Sujal Kanti Saha
-versus-
State of West Bengal.
In re : An application under Sections 397/401 read with Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
Mr. Dipanjan Chatterjee Mr. Snehansu Majumder ....for the petitioner.
Mr. Madhusudan Sur, ld. APP, Mrs. Ratna Ghosh ....for the State.

This revisional application was preferred challenging the order dated March 30, 2021 passed by the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Tehatta, Nadia in connection with S. L. No. 1184 of 2020 arising out of Tehatta P. S. Case No. 341 of 2020 dated August 19, 2020 under Sections 272/273/420 of the Indian Penal Code read with Section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Tehatta, Nadia
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Tehatta P. S. Case No. 341 of 2020
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Mr. Chatterjee, learned advocate appearing for the petitioner prays for return of the seized 18,000 kg of black cumin which were seized in the instant case by the Investigating Authorities.
The petitioner approached the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Tehatta, Nadia.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Tehatta, Nadia
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
However,
the learned A.C.J.M, Tehatta, Nadia rejected such an application.
Mr. Sur, learned Additional Public Prosecutor appears on behalf of the State and produces the case diary.
I find that the subject matter 18,000 kg of cumin was seized on 19th August, 2020.
A sample from the said cumin was sent for analysis on 20th August, 2020 to the Food Analyst by the Deputy Chief Medical Officer of Health, Nadia.
The samples referred therein do match with the report of the Public Analyst, which was submitted, opining the same to be unsafe for human consumption.

Having regard to the same, I am not inclined to interfere with the order dated 30th March, 2021 passed by the learned Additional chief Judicial Magistrate, Tehatta, Nadia.
Petitioner will take measures at the appropriate stage of the proceedings, if so advised.

entities.text: Additional chief Judicial Magistrate, Tehatta, Nadia
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the revisional application being CRR 1916 of 2021 is disposed of.
